transforms.code:
import re
	root = self.getChild("root")
	prov = self.custom.providers.list
	for p in prov:	
		u = value
		path = "[{0}]_types_/{1}".format(p,u)
		results = system.tag.browse(path, {"tagType":"AtomicTag"} )
		ds = []
		#pattern = r"(/[^/]+/[^/_]+)(_SP|_VARSP|_VCMD|_CMD|_VSIG|_MODE|SEC_DP_MODE)$"
		pattern = re.compile(r'.*(_SP|_VARSP|_VCMD|_CMD|_VSIG|_MODE|SEC_DP_MODE)$')
		for r in results:
			rp = str(r["fullPath"])
			match = re.search(pattern,rp) != None
			if match:
				j = {}
				j["tagpath"] = rp
				ds.append(j)
	return ds

transforms.code:
root = self.getChild("root")
	provider = self.custom.providers.list
	for prov in provider:
		query = root.getUdtTypeList(value)
		results = system.tag.query(prov, query)
		ds = []
		for r in results:
			tid =  str(r['typeId'])
			if tid not in ds:
				q = root.getInstances(tid)
				r =  system.tag.query(prov, q)
				if len(r) !=0:
					ds.append(tid)
	return ds
